grid.visualHeightMeaning: Meters per nominal integer plateau height; continuous ramp and true-stair support is separately explicit.
grid.visualHeightStatus: fixed D1 plateau heights and declared continuous support; exact acceptance scope is in geometryValidation
grid.shape: explicit coordinate set; bounding rectangle includes absent cells
grid.hexOrientation: pointy axial on Unity XZ; Unity Y is elevation

defaultEdgeRule.generation: Generate all six-neighbor directed edges in both directions, then apply sparse overrides. Missing reverse records are invalid, not inferred.

movementBurden.interpretation: Movement d_e = metric units + directed-edge extra units + destination-cell extra units. Attack metric remains 2 units per edge.
movementBurden.currentRuntimeGap: Current runtime supports destination-cell burden only; D2 must consume configured edge burden without changing attack metric.

placementNotes: Support and cover markers do not create occupancy or block movement in this D1 graph.
Their future scene-object type, material and interaction contracts remain D4/D9-D11 work.
Pair validation seeds are separate hypothetical snapshots, not simultaneous production spawns.

Pair placements retain the same-height rule; abs(deltaHeight)=1 is allowed only with explicit slope/stairs edges in both directions, matching edgeKind and connectionId, both movement-enabled and both clearance-qualified. Turn-then-follow, every 60-degree intermediate pose and rear sweep stay mandatory.

Layer heights and slope/stair dimensions are fixed for D1 under the recorded geometry scope. The current production importer does not yet support this definition; D2 implements the existing data chain and subsequent D3 implements runtime presentation.

physicalSurfaceProfiles.ends: Zero derivative at both endpoints; flat extension at endpoint Y outside the ramp domain.
physicalSurfaceProfiles.supportDomain: Unique support across the union of four-column covered hexes; inner two columns are stoppable, outer two are non-stoppable ramp_shoulder with blocksGroundMove=true and blocksLineOfSight=false. Clip original Tile tops/walls inside this footprint. Only listed lower/upper shared-edge portals are open.
physicalSurfaceProfiles.shoulderPresentation: D3 must visibly present the shoulder as non-traversable edge earthwork or gravel, not indistinguishable empty flat ground. The body swept-clearance region remains the same smooth support profile: no railing or protruding stones inside it. Decorations may occupy only the outer shoulder region after finite geometry establishes clearance.
physicalSurfaceProfiles.logicalHeightQuantization: lowerLevel below the worldZ midpoint; upperLevel above it; no half-level state. heightLevel alone remains rule input.
physicalSurfaceProfiles.turning: Use enumerated full pair poses/turns and finite profile shoulders plus horizontal platforms; no untested full-circle turning claim.
physicalSurfaceProfiles.geometryStatus: D1 fixed design accepted: all 390 legal stationary pair poses and two dynamic witness routes (1295 samples,1240 conservatively bounded intervals). This is not geometry validation of all 993 graph-legal dynamic transitions; see shared geometry evidence and D3 runtime obligations.

physicalStairConnections.stairSurfaceDefinition: At each riser worldZ, height increases by .09375; constant horizontal tread between consecutive risers. Before the first riser use lowerY, after the last use lowerY+.75. Profile domain is exactly the union of three covered hexes; vertical faces are the actual risers, with no hidden slope support.
physicalStairConnections.geometryStatus: D1 shared true-stair dimensions fixed: three stopping platforms validated in six facings, and actual player stepping sampled with lower-foot support and no body penetration. Finite domain is the declared three-hex footprint. Subsequent D3 runtime presentation must implement the measured stepping behavior.
physicalStairConnections.movingSupport: Each tested traversed pose has an actual lower foot support and no body penetration; simultaneous two-foot contact is required at the three stopping platforms, not during stepping. Subsequent D3 runtime presentation supplies foot lifting animation.
physicalStairConnections.supportOwnership: The three covered hexes bind this one stair authority, including both endpoint landings, midpoint landing and true treads. Clip original Tile tops inside the footprint. No hidden slope collider or second top. WorldZ profile is shared for all facings; axial center travel is 2m although worldZ separation is sqrt(3)m.
physicalStairConnections.logicalHeightQuantization: Midpoint platform remains at lowerLevel, upper platform at upperLevel; intermediate physical .375m rise is not a new rule height.

physicalSurfaceAuthority: One support function per XZ plane position in each occupied column. Profile-covered cells replace default tile tops and their hidden walls inside the footprint. All four ramp columns, including non-stoppable shoulders, use exactly the same worldZ profile. Rule movement and heights never sample Unity Transform. Adjacent physical mismatches remain closed even when rule height matches. Three true-stair stopping platforms use the same explicit stair support authority; its intermediate physical level does not create a rule height.
changeScope: Whole-layout replacement after the 121-cell candidate failed finite sidewall clearance; no inherited route cost or physical acceptance. Total144 support cells =105 stoppable +36 non-stoppable ramp shoulders +3 rocks.

Low/mid ramps: four physical columns q0..3 andq6..9 at rows1..6; inner q1..2/q7..8 stoppable. High ramp:q3..6 rows8..13, innerq4..5 stoppable. Each retains measured .75m rise/4.330127m worldZ half-cosine run.

Full low platform row0, full middle platform row7, full upper platform rows14..15 q3..9; central rows4..6 q4..5 and rightrow8 give middle approach support. No second top or wall inside any profile footprint.
Front-right true stair:q5 rows2/3/4; rear-right:q8 rows8/9/10. Three horizontal stopping platforms, two four-step flights, clearance1. No new only-pass rule or half-height rule state.

Three rocks relocate to0:0,4:3,9:15; two blocked wall spans relocate to8:14<->9:14 and8:15<->9:15; their movement/effect rules retained. Central rock4:3 replaces the otherwise isolated low cell; leaving4:2 free connects every stoppable cell. Subsequent D3 scene objects must remain within the recorded D1 clearance boundary and may not intrude into validated route sweeps.
The one-way high-to-mid drop moves to9:9>9:8, reverse blocked. Six water cells/two mud cells retain destination burden1 and are moved off support-only shoulders.
Common single/pair seed4:0,facing0,rear3:0; target8:12. Four public support markers and capability witness coordinates relocate explicitly below.

Inclining internal edges charge slope burden1 both ways including same-rule-height segments; isohypse edges are flat. Closed side edges, shoulder blocking, all body/turn/sweep rules and new path costs are independently enumerated.

coordinateMigration.migrationBasis: Marker old values refer to the committed original 100-cell candidate, not the rejected 121-cell experiment or old hypothetical pair seed2:0.
coordinateMigration.parentResponsibility: Update direct ability/assembly coordinate examples to these exact witnesses; no new ability rule or runtime range is introduced.
